transcript.text: The grill on my Hotpoint DD2540IX went bang with a bright flash and tripped the electrics. Reset the trip, oven works but grill is dead. There's a gap in the grill element. New element?

⚠ Stop using this appliance
Please don't keep resetting the trip. Leave the appliance unplugged and have it checked by a qualified electrician or appliance engineer before using it again. Yes, the grill element needs replacing. The 'bang' and flash indicate the internal heating coil has failed internally, likely touching the metal casing and causing a short circuit that tripped your mains protection. Please ensure the cooker is switched off at the wall before attempting any replacement. If you are not comfortable disconnecting the old element or installing the new one safely, please contact a qualified electrician or appliance engineer.

claimsRejected.claim: Since you have confirmed there is now a visible gap in the element, it cannot be repaired.
